boundaries.name: previous-balance-recursive-verification
boundaries.obligation: Derive that builder.verify_proof (line 226) under the verifier data carried inside the previous proof's own public inputs accepts only proofs of the balance circuit whose cyclic key equals that vd; the model takes acceptance as the opaque balanceProofAccepted callback and does not pin the vd.

boundaries.name: tx-settlement-and-spend-proof
boundaries.obligation: TxSettlementTarget::new (spend proof verified under the pinned spend vd, account state, tx-tree inclusion, spend_pis.tx == settled tx) and TxSettlement::new/spend_pis are premises (txSettlementAccepted, Spend.parse*). Booleanity of spend_pis.is_valid (BoolTarget::new_unsafe) is the FlagBoolean premise supplied by the spend proof, not a gate of this file. Nonce increment and the sent-tx tree root are never inspected here.

boundaries.name: transfer-merkle-inclusion-and-aux-semantics
boundaries.obligation: TransferWitnessTarget::new / TransferWitness::verify Merkle inclusion is the opaque transferInclusion callback. That aux_data equals the tx leaf hash (source SECURITY comment, lines 284-289, 'enforced off-circuit at co-sign time') is not modeled; the chain PI is only shown to fold whatever aux_data the leaf carries.

boundaries.name: update-public-state-gadget
boundaries.obligation: UpdatePublicStateTarget::new gates are the imported UpdatePublicState.CircuitGates premise with an opaque Merkle root callback; their lowering and the prev_public_state_root chain are that module's obligation.

boundaries.name: keccak-chain-fold-and-gadget-lowering
boundaries.obligation: settled_tx_chain_push(_circuit) is modeled by its 17-word [IMTC]++chain++aux preimage with keccak an opaque function (no collision resistance assumed); the keccak gadget, Bytes32 is_zero, U63 enforce_ge/enforce_gt range checks, select gadgets and field/word canonical conversion are the FieldAndGadgetLowering premise, unproved.

boundaries.name: balance-pi-codec-registration-and-plonky2-compilation
boundaries.obligation: BalanceFullPublicInputsTarget::from_pis/to_vec and register_public_inputs are the imported BalancePublicInputs codec; CircuitConfig, add_const_gate, builder.build, PartialWitness writes, data.prove and bincode/serde (de)serialization are opaque. No refinement of the compiled constraint system or of the Rust to this model.

boundaries.name: native-target-refinement
boundaries.obligation: The native builder accepts tx_block_number >= block_r while the circuit enforces tx_block_number > block_r (native_accepts_equal_tx_block_and_block_r vs circuit_rejects_equal_tx_block_and_block_r). Beyond circuit_output_is_next_inputs (same output formula on a gate-satisfying witness) and one concrete example, there is no proof that the circuit's accepted set refines the native builder's on real plonky2 witnesses.
